blocks.heading: Simple interest
lines: SI = P × R × T ÷ 100. Amount = P + SI.
Money doubles in n years at a rate of 100 ÷ n % a year.

blocks.heading: Compound interest
lines: Amount = P × (1 + R/100)^n, and CI = Amount - P.

blocks.heading: Half-yearly compounding
lines: Halve the rate and double the number of periods.
20% a year, half-yearly, for 1 year: 10% for 2 periods, 1.1 × 1.1 = 1.21.
